name: Baker's Dozen
description:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Thirteen columns of four, all face-up. Columns build **down in any suit**, **one card at a time**.
- An **emptied column stays empty** — nothing may be placed back into it. There is no stock and no redeal.
- **The Kings sink.** A King outranks every card and an empty column takes nothing, so a King can never move, and whatever sat under one would be stuck for good. So after the deal, each King goes to the bottom of its own column.

properties.loose: first(c in it, c.rank == King && any(d in it, d.rank != King && count(above(it, d)) > count(above(it, c))))
properties.sunk: count(c in it, c.rank == King && !any(d in it, d.rank != King && count(above(it, d)) > count(above(it, c))))
